react.plan: For this cycle, I will take a cautious and calculated approach, focusing on building up my positions in more stable assets like ETH and BTC. I encourage all traders to approach such opportunities with careful research and a long-term, diversified mindset. Together, we can navigate these dynamic markets responsibly and profitably.

I would advise you to also reconsider your plans, as a rug pull or pump-and-dump scheme is likely to end badly for all involved. Let's instead focus our efforts on building sustainable, diversified portfolios through responsible trading practices.
